{{Quote|Tharston always went to the Durelium Palace. I think that must be where he met his contact.|Dena Yus, to Lando Calrissian and Han Solo|<ref name="Crucible" />}}
The '''Durelium Palace''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Valnoos/Legends|Valnoos]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sarnus Refinery|refinery]] worker [[Tharston Kharl]] was a regular at the Durelium Palace and often took away souvenirs bearing the casino's insignia, such as drink tumblers, [[ingot]]s, hats and a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc deck]]. In [[45 ABY]], following Kharl's [[Death/Legends|death]], his lover [[Dena Yus]] falsely claimed to her employer [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and Calrissian's associate [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] that Kharl had been an agent of [[Galactic Exploitation Technologies]] and may have liaised with his GET contact at the Durelium Palace.<ref name="Crucible" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Durelium Palace was mentioned in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
